set.body:
Follow-ups from the ADR 0025 implementation review (landed at 1d448b96c):
1. story D1aEnvelopeSuite "node membership is rechecked independently of an available primary interval" asserts bare isLeft; assert the anchor-axis reason so it discriminates.
2. Rule 3 accepts the source axis of any TrackComposition whatever its target, so two foreign axes can name each other without reaching the primary. Requiring targetAxis == primaryAxis would tighten it; needs an owner decision (it narrows the accepted rule).
set.title: [evidence-binding] ADR 0025 follow-ups: discriminating story assertion; composition-target tightening
